excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]已经设法恢复了通往L-星团的道路！被称为L-星龙的巨大生物从每个现有的L-星门中出现，但他们似乎未展示出敌意。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetName] has managed to restore access to the L-Cluster! Giant creatures known as L-Drakes are emerging from every existing L-Gate, although they do not yet appear to be hostile.
